title: Bug Reopen Frequency
scenario: Identify bugs that transitioned from 'Resolved' back to 'Open' more than twice.
tableSchema: status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use LEAD() to check if status transitions match the 'Resolved' -> 'Open' pattern.
correctQuery: SELECT bug_id FROM (SELECT bug_id, status, LEAD(status) OVER(PARTITION BY bug_id ORDER BY changed_at) as next_status FROM status_history) t WHERE status = 'Resolved' AND next_status = 'Open' GROUP BY bug_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP);
